name: Lauren Gapczynski
role: Research Coordinator and Partnership Development Officer
bio: Lauren has worked in higher education from 2020 to 2025 through her role with Florida Atlantic University's Office of Undergraduate Research and Inquiry. In that role, she ran the LEARN program, which supports first year and AA/AS transfer students in their pursuit of undergraduate research. While earning her Bachelor's and Master's from FAU, Lauren conducted research on gopher tortoises and the species that use their burrows. In her role with Wahoo Bay, Lauren works with community members, partners and students interested in working with Wahoo Bay to help support them through the partnership and research process.
